book.title: Beach Read
book.author: Emily Henry
book.subtitle: A heartfelt contemporary romance about grief, healing and unexpected love by a summer lake.
book.description: January Andrews, reeling from grief and creative block, escapes to her late father’s lakeside cottage where she collides with her brooding neighbour Gus. As two writers confronting loss, identity, and buried emotion, they discover a connection that slowly deepens into love. The novel blends humour, emotional introspection, and romantic tension into a moving, character-driven story.

audienceMatch.title: Audience Insights

bisac.additional: Upmarket Fiction; Grief & Sudden Loss Fiction

audienceMatch.keyCharacteristics: The core readership consists of predominantly female adults aged 25–44 who seek emotionally resonant, character-driven fiction exploring grief, healing and intimate relationships. They favour romance with depth, authenticity and psychological nuance.

analysisOverview.title: Analysis Overview
analysisOverview.readership: Readers are emotionally engaged adults, especially women aged 25–44, who prioritise authenticity, resilience and emotional growth in their fiction. They gravitate toward grief-centred narratives, introspective character journeys and nuanced relationship storytelling. Both primary and secondary audiences show strong online behaviour, discovering books via Instagram, BookTok, Goodreads and book clubs, with consistent monthly reading habits.
analysisOverview.classification: The book sits at the intersection of contemporary romance and upmarket women's fiction, offering emotional realism, grief exploration and literary-leaning introspection. It fits comfortably within small-town summer romances with psychological depth and occupies a competitive space alongside titles by Emily Henry, Christina Lauren, and Sally Rooney, distinguished by its bittersweet tone and authentic portrayal of creative and personal recovery.
analysisOverview.personas: Two clear personas emerge: Amelia, a creative, introspective millennial seeking emotional catharsis and authenticity; and Daniel, a mature, emotionally curious reader drawn to character-driven fiction that expands his emotional vocabulary. Both connect deeply with themes of grief, transformation, and slow-building romantic tension.
analysisOverview.marketingGuidance: Marketing should emphasise emotional healing, lakeside intimacy and a blend of humour and heartache. Position it as a summer read for fans of emotionally intelligent romance, using BookTok aesthetics, influencer-driven campaigns and strong character-led hooks. Emotional storytelling, grief-to-healing arcs and upmarket packaging will maximise reach across romance, women’s fiction and book club channels.

positioning.title: Emotional Romance with Literary Depth
positioning.subtitle: Positioned at the intersection of contemporary romance and upmarket women’s fiction
positioning.description: This novel occupies a refined niche between heartfelt romance and emotionally resonant literary fiction. With its portrayal of grief, self-discovery, and romantic tension, it will appeal to readers of contemporary romance seeking more character depth and emotional realism. The title distinguishes itself by layering introspective themes with a moderate romantic heat, creating an emotionally engaging, thought-provoking reading experience targeted at readers looking for more than escapism in the romance genre.

moodAndTone.title: Bittersweet and Reflective
moodAndTone.subtitle: An introspective tone tinged with humor and heartfelt romantic uncertainty
moodAndTone.description: The mood of the novel combines romantic longing, emotional healing, and bittersweet introspection. Narrated in a conversational, witty first-person voice, it interweaves humorous exchanges with undercurrents of grief and personal growth. The emotional arc progresses from a place of numbing loss toward a hopeful 'happy-for-now,' against a vividly nostalgic, intimate summer lakeside backdrop.

marketing.title: From Grief to Gratitude: A Lakeside Love Campaign
marketing.subtitle: A global marketing campaign for a moving, upmarket romance blending emotional complexity, humour and healing.
marketing.objective: Drive discovery, engagement, and robust sales among adult readers of contemporary romance and upmarket women's fiction, highlighting emotional appeal and strong reader identification with themes of grief, love, and self-discovery.
marketing.keyInsight: Romantic fiction readers increasingly seek emotionally resonant, character-driven narratives reflecting real challenges—from grief to identity—to which they can deeply relate. Positioning the book with authentic emotional storytelling and visually compelling small-town romance imagery will maximise resonance and cultural traction.
howToUse: Distribute this strategy to internal marketing, PR, and sales teams to align messaging and scheduling.
Utilise the copy assets and tagline across title metadata, trade catalogues, and online platforms.
Deploy funnel-based campaign activations to guide readers from awareness to conversion.
Liaise with influencer managers to prioritise BookTok and Bookstagram coverage.
Provide creatives and messaging to international rights agents and translators.
primaryKPIs: Engagement rate across social media campaigns
Influencer UGC volume on TikTok and Instagram
Review count and average ratings on Goodreads and Amazon

funnels.name: Awareness
funnels.description: Introduce the title as an emotionally rich summer read that blends romance, grief and self-discovery for fans of Emily Henry and Christina Lauren.
funnels.formats: Trailer videos, influencer unboxings, cover reveals, paid social ads, book community features
funnels.optimisation: Amplify on-trend content formats tailored to BookTok (e.g., slow-burn romance, ‘books that healed me’), and segment creatives by sentiment.

funnels.name: Consideration
funnels.description: Engage potential readers with samplers, author interviews, excerpt content and emotional reader reviews.
funnels.formats: Instagram carousels, TikTok annotations, long-form email newsletters, author TikTok Q&As
funnels.optimisation: Use A/B tested headlines focusing on healing/loss/love; feature choice quotes to evoke emotional connection.

funnels.name: Conversion
funnels.description: Drive pre-orders and purchases tied to emotional calls-to-action ideal for book clubs and individual readers.
funnels.formats: Retailer-specific landing pages, discounts for early buyers, email reminders, retargeting social ads
funnels.optimisation: Optimise timing during late spring/early summer, with location targeting for key physical events and UK retailer promotions.

budgetAllocation.title: Multi-Channel Budget Allocation
budgetAllocation.breakdown: 40% digital advertising (Meta, Google, TikTok), 25% influencer and social content creation, 15% PR and media placements, 10% events and festivals, 10% print and out-of-home promotions (select UK and US markets).

flightSchedule.title: Summer Sync Launch
flightSchedule.timeline: 8-week campaign starting 6 weeks prior to publication (May–July), timed to peak during UK/US summer holiday reads period. Ongoing post-launch social media engagement and seasonal promotions through September.
